mapper.select: SELECT * FROM moderation_reports WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE moderation_reports SET status = #{status}, llm_provider = #{llmProvider}, llm_model = #{llmModel}, llm_decision = #{llmDecision}, llm_confidence = #{llmConfidence}, llm_summary = #{llmSummary}, failure_code = NULL, failure_reason = NULL, reviewed_at = NOW(3), updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'pending'

UPDATE moderation_reports SET status = 'ignored', llm_provider = #{llmProvider}, llm_model = #{llmModel}, llm_decision = #{llmDecision}, llm_confidence = #{llmConfidence}, llm_summary = #{llmSummary}, failure_code = #{failureCode}, failure_reason = #{failureReason}, reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt}, updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'pending'

UPDATE moderation_reports SET retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, failure_code = #{failureCode}, failure_reason = #{failureReason}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'pending'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM moderation_reports WHERE status = 'pending' AND next_retry_at IS NOT NULL AND next_retry_at <= #{now} ORDER BY next_retry_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
